author: Remarkable-Touch-507
body:
Your build is solid for T9. Keep going to T10. Builds become more specialized at that point. 

At this point focus on survivability and equip 2% ward adornments on everything. Upgrade all gear to 10 and if you have enough materials you should master forge some gear too. 

Best of luck!!
